links.outcome: Readability of chatbot-translated MRI reports (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease, Gunning Fog)
links.effect: Both chatbots significantly improved readability; Chatbot 2 achieved higher Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease scores (median 58.70 vs. 46.00, p < 0.001) and lower text complexity.
links.quote: Both chatbots significantly improved readability, with Chatbot 2 achieving higher Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease scores (median: 58.70 vs. 46.00, p < 0.001) and lower text complexity.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation comparing two LLMs (GPT o1-preview and DeepSeek-R1) in translating MRI reports into patient-friendly language; it evaluates baseline model performance rather than a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
